City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 20, 2017 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.

2.

3.

Presentation on the San Elijo Lagoon Restoration Project by Executive Director Doug Gibson.
4B.
Presentation of Certificate of Recognition to Richard Dascomb for over 40 years of dedicated service as an employee and volunteer of the Fire Department.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 15, 2017 Regular Meeting, November 29, 2017 Regular Meeting and the November 29, 2017 Special Meeting Closed Session. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2017-12-20 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2017-12-20 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Authorization for the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records. Contact Person: Records Management Coordinator Colombo
City Council adopt Resolution 2017-102 authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records in accordance with the City's Records Retention Schedule and Government Code.
2017-12-20 Item 08C Authorization of Non-Essential, Non-Permanent Records Destruction
8D.
Proposed Reclassification of Three (3) Fire Engineer Positions to Three (3) Fire Captain Positions in the Fire and Marine Safety Department assigned to Fire Station #6 in Olivenhain. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
Adopt Resolution No. 2017-111 (Attachment 1) approving the reclassification of three (3) Fire Engineers to three (3) Fire Captains in the Fire and Marine Safety Department assigned to Fire Station #6 in Olivenhain.
2017-12-20 Item 08D Resolution 2017-111 Proposed Reclassification in Fire Department
8E.
City of Encinitas Legislative Program for 2018. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
City Council reviews and approves the draft 2018 Legislative Program.
2017-12-20 Item 08E 2018 Legislative Program
8F.
Resolution 2017-108 Supporting the Move Toward Ending Cage Confinement of Farm Animals. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
That City Council approves Resolution 2017-108 supporting the move toward ending cage confinement of farm animals.
2017-12-20 Item 08F Cage Free Resolution 2017-108
8G.
Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project - Memorandum of Agreement, Special Permit Conditions, Contract and Budget Amendment and Long Term Maintenance. Contact Person: Program Administrator Weldon
1) Approve the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between California Department of Parks and Recreation and the City of Encinitas for Long Term Maintenance of the Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Project (Attachment 1) in substantial form as attached in consultation with the City Attorney; 2) Accept the California Coastal Commission (CCC) Notice of Intent to Issue Permit and Special Conditions (Attachment 2); 3) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to amend the contract between Encinitas and Moffatt & Nichol in the amount not to exceed $50,000 for Project Management and $30,000 for Project Scope Modification due to the additional Prior to Issuance Permit Requirements (Attachment 3); 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2017-114 Amending the Fiscal Year 2017-18 budget to appropriate $283,074 in grant funds to CP16A (Attachment 4); and 5) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to encumber dune repair/restoration funds, not to exceed $25,000 annually, from the Coastal Zone Management Fund, to fulfill permit conditions.
2017-12-20 Item 08G Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project
8H.
Contract Amendment for private development construction inspection services. Contact Person: City Planner Sapaâ€™u
1) Authorize the Director of Development Services, or the Directorâ€™s designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to an existing agreement with Geopacifica Inc. in the amount of $501,200 (up to six month period), plus 15% contingencies, for a total contract amount not to exceed $797,067 and to extend the existing contract for three months to March 31, 2018 with a three-month extension option to June 30, 2018, to be authorized by the City Manager as deemed necessary for staff to assess and implement the long-term solution for private development construction inspection; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2017-112 entitled, â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Adopted Budgetâ€ authorizing an additional appropriation of $399,598 (Attachment CC-1).
2017-12-20 Item 08H Geopacifica Amendment
2017-12-20 Item 08H Attachment CC-1 FY 18 Budget Resolution - 2017-112 (Amended 12-18-2017)
8I.
Resolution 2017-115 opposing California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) proposed Resolution E-4907. Contact Person: Acting CAP Program Administrator Najera
1) Adopt Resolution 2017-115, titled â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Opposing California Public Utilities Commission proposed Resolution E-4907â€ (Attachment 1); and 2) Direct staff to send Resolution 2017-115 and comments on proposed resolution E-4907 to the California Public Utilities Commission for consideration.
2017-12-20 Item 08I Resolution 2017-115 Opposing CPUC Proposed Resolution E-4907
8J.
Fiscal Year 2017-18 First Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1. Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2017-18 First Quarter Budget Status Report; and 2. Adopt Resolution No. 2017-113 titled â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Budgetâ€ (Attachment 1)
2017-12-20 Item 08J FY 2017-18 1st Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Amendments
2017-12-20 Item 08J FY 2017-18 1st Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Amendments (Amended 12-19-2017)
8K.
License Agreements for the Chesterfield Drive Rail Crossing and for improvements along San Elijo Avenue south of Chesterfield Drive. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Amended and Restated License Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) (in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1) for construction and maintenance of improvements in the rail right-of-way at Chesterfield Drive; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the License Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) (in substantial form as provided in Attachment 2) for the construction of improvements on San Elijo Avenue south of Chesterfield Drive by the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) and ultimate maintenance of the improvements by the City.
2017-12-20 Item 08K Chesterfield Drive
8L.
Agreement between the City of Encinitas and the San Diego County for the Provision of Library Services at the Encinitas Library. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the Agreement between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego County Library for Provision of Library Services at the Encinitas Library.
2017-12-20 Item 08L Library Services Agreement
8M.
Interim North Coast Highway 101 Improvements. Contact Person: City Engineer Magdosku
1) Direct staff to continue with the proposed interim enhancements/improvements and the addition of two mid-block crossings on North Coast Highway 101; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2017-109 entitled, â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Adopted Budgetâ€ authorizing an additional appropriation of $150,000 to fund interim improvements on N. Coast Highway 101 (Attachment 1).
2017-12-20 Item 08M Interim 101 Improvements
8N.
As-Needed Civil Engineering and Project Management Contracts. Contact Person: City Engineer Magdosku
1) Authorize the Development Services Director, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to contracts, and any necessary task orders and time extensions, with Dokken Engineering, Latitude 33 Planning and Engineering, NV5, Inc., Dudek, Nasland Engineering, and STC Traffic, Inc., each in an amount for $150,000, for total contracts not exceeding $300,000 for As-Needed Civil Engineering Services. The total authorization with the amendments is $1,800,000; and 2) Authorize the Development Services Director, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to contracts, and any necessary task orders and time extensions, with Hoch Consulting in an amount for $150,000, for a total contract authorization not exceeding $725,000 for As-Needed Civil Engineering Services.
2017-12-20 Item 08N As-Needed Contract Amendments
8O.
North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project (CS04D) Design Amendment to Existing Contract with Michael Baker International (MBI). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Authorize the Development Services Director, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the design contract with MBI in an amount of $8,910 for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,584,111 for a Green Streets Storm Water Quality Management Plan (SWQMP) and associated plan revisions to ensure project compliance prior to approval of the Coastal Development Permit (CDP) for the project; and 2) Discuss and provide direction regarding the option to include in the Streetscape project a multi-use trail in the rail right-of-way on the east side of North Coast Highway 101 from A Street to La Costa Avenue at an estimated construction cost of $895,000 for a trail running the entire corridor. If desired, authorize the Development Services Director, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an additional amendment to the design contract with MBI in an amount of $66,330, including a 10% contingency, for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,650,441.
2017-12-20 Item 08O Streetscape Michael Baker Complete
8P.
Mobility Project Update - Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Magdosku
1) Receive report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects; and 2) Receive report on the status of the effort to develop a publicly available GIS map of active projects.
2017-12-20 Item 08P Mobility Projects Update
8Q.
Urban Forestry Tree Care Services Agreement. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
Authorize the City Manager to execute, in consultation with the City Attorney, an agreement substantially conforming to the requirements specified in Request for Proposal 2017-06 with attached standard City contract (Attachment 1) for Urban Forestry Tree Care Services with West Coast Arborists, Inc. for an initial four-year term, and authorize the City Manager to extend the agreement for two three-year renewal options not exceeding ten years total. The agreement and renewal options are not to exceed the annual budgeted amount.
2017-12-20 Item 08Q West Coast Arborist
8R.
Fire and Security Systems Service Agreement. Contact Person: Management Analyst Wilson
1) City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute the Fire and Security Systems Service Agreement for City facilities between the City of Encinitas and Progressive Technology Security Systems, Inc. for the initial three-year term with an option to extend the Agreement for one three-year renewal upon satisfactory performance and mutual agreement for a total amount not to exceed $483,632 (Attachment 1); and 2) City Council approves a budget amendment of $16,834, of which $16,474 is from the unallocated General Fund balance (Attachment 2).
2017-12-20 Item 08R Fire and Security Systems
2017-12-20 Item 08R Fire and Security Systems - Budgetary Fund Balance Summary (Added 12-18-2017)

Deny the appeal, and adopt attached Draft Resolution No. 2017-104 (Attachment CC-1) affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the Final Map and the projectâ€™s associated CC&Rs. This option approves the Final Map and CC&Rs as approved by the Planning Commission, with no changes.

1) Receive the report and provide input on the second draft of the CMLS specific to the RCVS and the portion of the ATP within the rail corridor; and 2) Provide staff direction, as desired.
2017-12-20 Item 10B CMLS 2nd Draft

Presentation of the City's Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2017. Contact Person: Finance Manager Huang

2017.
2017-12-20 Item 10C FY2016-17 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report

Discussion and selection of the Deputy Mayor. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Council to select one of its members as Deputy Mayor.
2017-12-20 Item 10D Selection of Deputy Mayor
10E.
Discussion and Possible Appointments of Encinitas City Council Members to Regional Boards, Commissions, and Committees, and Consideration and Possible Action Regarding Appointments to Standing Subcommittees, Active Ad-Hoc Subcommittees and Council Liaisons. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
1) Council to make recommendation and approve final appointments of Representative and Alternate to the North County Transit District (NCTD) 2018 Board of Directors; 2) Council to make recommendation and approve final appointments of Representative, Alternate and Second Alternate to the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) 2018 Board of Directors; 3) Mayor to make recommendations and Council to approve all other 2018 regional board, commission and committee appointments; and 4) Council to consider and possibly take action regarding appointments to standing subcommittees, active ad-hoc subcommittees and Council liaisons.
2017-12-20 Item 10E Regional Committee and Board Appointments
10F.
Amendment No. 1 to City Managerâ€™s Employment Contract. Contact Person: Council Sub-Committee Members Blakespear and Muir
Approve Amendment No. 1 to the City Managerâ€™s Employment Agreement increasing the annual base compensation by $4,760 for a total of $242,760 effective June 1, 2017.
2017-12-20 Item 10F City Manager Contract
10G.
Addendum No. 3 to City Attorneyâ€™s Professional Services Agreement. Contact Person: Council Sub-Committee Members Blakespear and Muir
1) Approve Addendum No. 3 to the City Attorneyâ€™s Professional Services Agreement effective June 1, 2017; and 2) Approve Resolution 2017-116 amending the Fiscal year 17/18 Budget in the amount of $36,950.
2017-12-20 Item 10G City Attorney Contract
2017-12-20 Item 10G City Attorney Contract (Amended 12-19-2017)

INFORMATIONAL ITEMS

Housing Element Update Status Report. Contact Person: Council Subcommittee Members Blakespear and Kranz

ADJOURNMENT - THE DECEMBER 27, 2017 REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING HAS BEEN CANCELED. THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 10, 2018.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
